title: No sound of BG Readings Missed Alert in silent mode
symptom: xDrip sends a notification for 'BG Readings Missed' but it is without sound, even though 'Override Silent Mode' is on and a sound is selected. The issue occurs on Android 10 after an update.
evidence_quote: xDrip sends message (about/when "BG Readings Missed") in Android notification panel, but it is without sound. "Override Silent Mode" option in alerts settings is turned on and sound for alert is selected.
